maddeler.e:
نكتمل (form VIII)
# نَكْتَمِلُ (naktamilu) /nak.ta.mi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَمَلَ (iktamala)
# نَكْتَمِلَ (naktamila) /nak.ta.mi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَمَلَ (iktamala)
# نَكْتَمِلْ (naktamil) /nak.ta.mil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِكْتَمَلَ (iktamala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
